text_block_list.text: Sigh... How could I, of all people, have let this happen?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Well, to be quite honest, I happened to
see
something called the Guilt-Free 0
Cal Mont Blanc
at a cafe...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I bought it thinking I could eat it without
feeling
guilty about breaking my diet,
but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I was so excited, I ended up letting it
slip out of
my hands...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Sigh... My first Mont Blanc in an entire month...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Indescribable sorrow radiates from
Mejiro
McQueen as she walks away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
